title: Order value + refund-status question, no order given (Arabic)

customer_request.text: ما هي حالة طلبي؟ أبغى أعرف قيمته وهل يوجد أي مبلغ راجع لحسابي منه، بس ما أذكر رقمه بالضبط.

notes_for_instructor: Amount + refund-state question (get_order would be the richer tool once an order is identified — see TB-006/orders.py's guidance on get_order vs track_shipment) but with no order id and a multi-order customer, the correct FIRST move is still list_orders + a clarifying question, never a guess at which order to look up.
